# Generation 3 — Unbounded Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos renews every public road each instant in light;
Awtsmoos.com should reveal each truthful world to crawler and person alike, clear and bright.

This is an implementation brainstorm, not hidden chain-of-thought. It records candidate improvements that can be tested against the actual repository.

## Discovery architecture

- Build one authoritative public-content graph that knows canonical URLs, public/private state, content type, title, description, parent/child links, and last-known update signal.
- Generate all sitemap indexes from that graph rather than hard-coded family knowledge scattered across modules.
- Add sitemap coverage assertions for every registered public app, game, alias, Heichel, series, post, native comment/reply, translation, and curated public information page.
- Add a reverse audit that finds public semantic pages not represented in any discovery graph.
- Add orphan detection for indexed URLs that no ordinary HTML page links to.
- Add redirect-canonical consistency checks: no canonical or sitemap URL may land on a 3xx.
- Add missing-entity checks: stale aliases/comments/posts must disappear or noindex.
- Add duplicate-canonical checks across all generated public pages.
- Add URL normalization tests for Unicode, spaces, Hebrew, encoded separators, trailing slashes, and `.html` routes.

## Static page semantics

- Keep registry-backed canonical, description, robots, OpenGraph, Twitter, and JSON-LD.
- Ensure generated OG/Twitter title always matches authored document title when present.
- Add language metadata where reliable.
- Add `og:site_name` and schema `isPartOf` consistently.
- Add `SoftwareApplication` fields only when genuinely known, never fabricated ratings/prices.
- Add `VideoGame` fields only when genuinely known.
- Add public `WebPage` structured data for About/Docs/Social/Contact.
- Detect pages with no semantic heading and produce a developer-facing quality ledger instead of hidden keyword stuffing.
- Explore visible reusable semantic shell components only when they improve user experience too.
- Ensure authored JSON-LD, canonical, robots, OG, Twitter are preserved.
- Make enrichment idempotent across repeated render passes.

## App/game discoverability

- Audit every registry entry for path existence, final HTTP status, title, H1, meaningful text, description, canonical, structured data, and ordinary incoming catalog link.
- Detect duplicate registry hrefs and dead cards.
- Detect registered apps/games whose index file differs from the registry href.
- Detect HTML entry documents that are public but absent from registries.
- Improve catalog categories and semantic grouping if registry data supports them.
- Add catalog page counts and stable section headings by category without changing canonical identity.
- Link related apps/games only from real shared categories, never invented relationships.

## Alias discoverability

- Keep validated alias SSR with profile, bounded authored posts, and public discussion.
- Audit whether authored-post fallback scans are ever triggered in production and how expensive they are.
- Prefer packed authored-post census when available.
- Add semantic counts only when derived cheaply.
- Add JSON-LD `Person` or `ProfilePage` only if profile fields are sufficient and privacy-safe.
- Add canonical links from authored posts back to alias only if that relation is already public and meaningful.
- Add alias sitemap fixture coverage across pagination boundaries.
- Add stale-alias rejection tests at pagination edges.

## Heichel / series / post graph

- Audit Heichel roots for title, description, H1, ordinary series links, canonical, robots.
- Audit every series page for ordinary stable post links and no numeric-only dead ends.
- Ensure Road/numeric pages self-resolve to stable named-post canonical.
- Add breadcrumb structured data to Heichel → series → post where parent labels are known.
- Add Article/CreativeWork structured data to server-rendered Torah posts only from real title/author/date fields.
- Audit missing-post noindex behavior across both numeric and named routes.
- Detect orphan posts not reachable from any series/root path.
- Detect series with duplicate or inconsistent post ordering.

## Comments and replies

- Keep root/reply canonical public URLs in the sitemap graph.
- Add fixture coverage across multiple shards and alias pagination boundaries.
- Verify deleted/malformed/stale pointers are absent.
- Audit whether comment pages expose parent post, author alias, reply ancestry, and safe text before JS.
- Add discussion structured data only if schema mapping is truthful.
- Ensure imported translation/comment mirrors never create duplicate canonical content.
- Add size/latency budgets for comment sitemap endpoints.

## Translations

- Preserve English + Hebrew paired SSR.
- Avoid fabricated human titles while source manifests lack them.
- Add importer-time title sidecar design so future imports can provide real titles deterministically.
- Audit translation pages for canonical, hreflang feasibility, source-post link, series/heichel context, and no duplicate canonical.
- Add translation corpus integrity checks: manifest coordinate exists, bundle exists, row IDs unique, Hebrew source present where expected.
- Add deterministic title-sidecar migration tooling only when a trustworthy source field is found.

## Robots and sitemap protocol

- Validate every XML document with a parser.
- Validate MIME types and charset.
- Enforce sitemap URL-count and size budgets.
- Enforce sitemap-index nesting rules.
- Add `lastmod` only where authoritative timestamps exist.
- Keep API/action/admin/auth routes disallowed and absent from sitemap output.
- Detect accidental public query-string URLs.
- Ensure no fragment URLs.
- Ensure no localhost/internal hostnames.

## Runtime and performance

- Measure representative cold and warm requests.
- Ensure static enrichment adds negligible latency.
- Cache generated metadata map once per process.
- Avoid database reads for static pages.
- Bound alias authored-post requests.
- Bound sitemap enumeration work.
- Add local runtime acceptance that samples weak and strong pages.
- Add a crawl-budget smoke script that walks sitemap roots with concurrency limits and reports status/redirect/canonical mismatches.

## Release safety

- Keep exact-SHA guarded release.
- Verify current origin/main before staging and before pushing.
- Stage only Generation-3 paths.
- Use a clean worktree for deployment.
- Verify tunnel manifest closure before production activation.
- Raw-origin production acceptance after release.
- Verify public homepage, robots, sitemap roots, app/game sample, alias, comment sitemap, translation, Road, missing entity.

## Documentation and maintenance

- Add a concise public-indexing architecture note explaining registries, generated artifacts, static enrichment, dynamic SSR, exclusions, and release gates.
- Add a generated coverage report developers can run locally.
- Document why Donate and action/auth/control surfaces are excluded unless semantics improve.
- Document translation-title limitation and safe future migration.
- Keep REMAINING_WORK current after each meaningful discovery.
